referenceSources.title: BEN RITROVATA, 106 RALLYE! | Peugeot | Stellantis Media
referenceSources.description:
Peugeot Italia has meticulously restored a 106 Rallye 1.3 to its original 1993 specification and added it to its press fleet. The compact white hatchback features distinctive red and yellow rally stripes, white steel wheels, and red interior accents, reflecting its lightweight, no-frills design. Under the hood, a 1.3‑liter TU2J2 engine produces 98 CV at 7,200 rpm, enabling a top speed of 190 km/h and a 0–100 km/h time of 9.3 seconds.

Celebrated as the sportiest version of the 106, the Rallye bridged the success of the iconic 205 and 206 models. Its economical mechanics, modern styling, and nimble handling made it a mass-market hit, with 2.8 million units sold worldwide. In motorsport, over 50,000 Peugeot 106s competed in Italian rallies across 22 seasons, dominating classes N and A, and filling grids in the Italian Touring Car Championship. Notable drivers such as Giorgio Faletti and Paolo Andreucci began their careers behind its wheel, cementing the Rallye’s legacy in both road and racing history.
